Bug_Title: Return values should not be ignored when they contain the operation status code
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded by ignoring the return values of the File.delete() and Lock.tryLock() methods, which contain the operation status code. This can lead to unintended behavior if the operations fail, as there is no way to handle the failures.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case attempts to delete a file that is read-only, which should fail. Additionally, the test case attempts to acquire a lock that is already held by the main thread, which should also fail. Both these operations return a status code indicating the success of the operation, and the test case asserts that these return values are false, indicating a failure. If the return values were ignored, these failures would go unnoticed.
